dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular polygonal and 'O' shaped light-intensity perimeters present in the mid-dorsal region; gradients transition abruptly from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light-grey interior fills.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density; several isolated clusters of high-intensity white pixels observed near the upper anterior region and sporadically along the mid-dorsal line lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most defined circular structures in the mid-flank region form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented approximately parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, interlocking reticulated network of light-intensity lines creating a jigsaw-like topology across the central and lateral midsection.
